name: Agent Simulation Search Planning Expansion Inventory
summary: Declarative expansion and refinement inventory for agent, simulation, search, route, game, and constrained-planning pipeline adaptations.

operations.name: PPO Policy Optimization
operations.intent: Insert PPO or multi-agent PPO policy optimization between simulator/search rollouts and final constraint repair when the solution depends on learned action policies.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Use PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) or Multi-Agent PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) to improve action policies from rollout trajectories before selecting a feasible plan.

rewrite.before_summary: Candidates are generated and evaluated by search or rollout before feasibility repair.
rewrite.after_summary: PPO policy optimization refines rollout behavior or action scoring before feasibility repair and final plan selection.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Preserves the plan-selection contract while adding a learned policy-improvement loop over simulated trajectories.

uncertainty_notes: Only use when policy optimization is load-bearing; ordinary greedy local search or hand-coded heuristics should use lighter planning refinements.

audit.provenance: Derived from validation gap mining after the 130-template expansion-aware validation run.
audit.rationale: PPO and multi-agent PPO recurred across remaining unmatched planning-style validation cases and was not covered by existing expansion operations.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This asset records PPO as a reusable planning-loop refinement rather than requiring a new base CDG.

references.title: Sciona expansion 130-template round-3 gap mining
